contract.note: Reading 'won't go away' as practical persistence (errors corrected or not, downstream reuse) is an ordinary reading and not stretched. But the speaker gave no duration and no meaning for 'go away', so the result depends on that interpretation.

evidence.note: A JMIR evaluation, dated July 2025, that publishes Deep Research output with its errors labelled as test material. This is not contamination of the literature, so it does not establish the antecedent and says nothing about persistence.

reviews.rationale: The antecedent is not established: the packet has no verified case of a Deep Research error entering the scientific literature as accepted content. No correction or citation record exists either. The conditional cannot be scored on this evidence, so it stays unresolved.
